time_series_query.prometheus_query:
sum by ("volume","aggr","node","svm","cluster","name")(avg_over_time({"__name__"="custom.googleapis.com/volume_size_total","monitored_resource"="k8s_cluster"}[${__interval}])) * on(volume) group_left(name,accountName) label_replace(
    sum by ("accountName","name")(avg_over_time({"__name__"="custom.googleapis.com/eligibility/v2/volume","monitored_resource"="gce_instance","storageClass"="hardware"}[${__interval}])),
    "volume", "$1", "name", "(.*)"
)
